payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with state (index, vitamin_mask) over n juices, each with price and vitamin set; computes min cost to achieve each mask using first i items.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over juices, updating a DP table dp[i][mask] = min cost to get vitamins mask from first i juices. Bitmask state has 8 values (3 vitamins), making it a 2D DP.
